title: Render homework completion and grading UI with disposable browser proof
verify: The existing Lesson Context page renders the homework item, class-visible completion statuses, the Student completion control, and the Admin/Teacher grade selector using only the server projection and named actions from TASK-105.

A disposable Playwright flow creates the missing item as Admin or the assigned Teacher, marks it complete as Student, records α, β, γ, and F in permitted Teacher/Admin cases, reloads, and proves the completion status and grade persistence.

The browser flow proves class-visible completion without shared grade leakage and proves corresponding student/linked-family grade access plus unrelated Student/unlinked-Parent denial through fresh server responses.
The disposable runner uses only tmp/ft-005-homework-grading-ui.db and exact sidecars, cleans up on success and failure, and never uses study-calendar.db.

evidence: Fresh disposable Playwright passed 1 test covering Admin creation, Student completion/reload persistence, class-visible completion, α/β/γ/F grade persistence, corresponding Student/linked-Parent visibility, unrelated Student/unlinked-Parent denial, and cleanup.
Fresh npm run check, npm run build, DATABASE_URL=:memory: npm run test (76 files / 260 tests), and git diff --check all exited 0.
Fresh independent T3 semantic verification found no material finding or operator question and confirmed the accepted FT-005 AC-001/AC-002 claim set.
The semantic protocol contains exactly one SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass; the functional protocol contains exactly one VERDICT: PASS.

verify.cause: Fresh functional PASS and required T3 semantic-pass satisfy TASK-106-T3-FT-005-W38; the same existing Judge returned JUDGE_ASSESSMENT: SUPPORT with stable_delivery.
verify.judge: JUDGE_ASSESSMENT: SUPPORT; trajectory_signal: stable_delivery; transition TASK-106 in_progress -> done, then run W38 /mb-sync and canonical boundary gates while preserving identity, scope, tier, dependencies, W38, and hard boundaries.

evidence_required: FT-005-AC-001 / REQ-009 RED: the browser cannot create the missing item as Admin/assigned Teacher, cannot complete it as Student, loses the completion after reload, or fails to show the class-visible status; GREEN: disposable Playwright proves Admin/assigned-Teacher creation, the Student completion action, and fresh server-rendered status for permitted class viewers after reload; artifact: .tasks/TASK-106-T3-FT-005-W38/ and .protocols/TASK-106-T3-FT-005-W38/.

FT-005-AC-002 / REQ-009 / REQ-014 RED: the UI omits α/β/γ/F, loses a recorded grade, shows a grade in shared completion data, or exposes it to an unrelated Student/unlinked Parent; GREEN: disposable Playwright proves permitted Teacher/Admin entry, persistence, corresponding student/linked-family visibility, and unrelated Student/unlinked-Parent denial; artifact: .tasks/TASK-106-T3-FT-005-W38/ and .protocols/TASK-106-T3-FT-005-W38/.
purpose: Close the browser-facing homework completion and grading gap in the existing Lesson Context page and provide the requested Playwright proof.
success_outcome: Students can mark homework complete, permitted class viewers can see completion status, and Admin/assigned Teacher can set α/β/γ/F with persisted privacy-correct display through the existing Lesson Context page.
anti_goals: Do not create a new homework page, route, client-wide store, browser persistence, mutation API, or direct database access.
Do not implement authorization or student/homework identity resolution in the Svelte component; consume TASK-105's server projection and actions.
Do not expose grades in shared Student/Parent completion UI or change attendance, payment, schema, or unrelated browser surfaces.
Do not run the browser flow against study-calendar.db or leave disposable database sidecars after the run.
constraints: Use only the existing /lesson-context page and the server projection/actions supplied by TASK-105; /api/lesson-context remains GET-only.
Keep browser state at the page level and rely on fresh server data after actions; do not add a client-wide homework store or browser persistence.
Render server-provided student labels and status data without trusting client role, center, class, lesson, student, or homework identifiers.
Run Playwright with scripts/run-disposable-e2e.mjs and a separate tmp/ft-005-homework-grading-ui.db; never use study-calendar.db.
Capture state before and after denied privacy/action cases and clean up in failure-safe paths.
invariants: Student completion remains class-visible only within the server-authorized scope.
Shared completion UI contains no grade data.
Grades display only for the corresponding student/family, assigned Teacher, or Admin.
Reload reads persisted server state rather than a client-only optimistic result.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-001: disposable browser proof covers Student completion, class-visible status, server response, reload persistence, and permitted scope.

FT-005-AC-002: disposable browser proof covers Admin/assigned Teacher grade entry for α/β/γ/F, persistence, corresponding student/linked-family display, and unrelated Student/unlinked-Parent denial without grade leakage.
Component/route review proves the UI contains no direct database access, authority resolution, new route, mutation API, or unrelated feature change.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-redesign if the UI requires a new route, mutation API, persistence source, lesson relation, or authority rule beyond TASK-105.
Stop if the browser flow requires trusting client role, center, student, homework, or scope claims, or if denied grade privacy cannot be proved after a fresh server response.
Stop if Playwright requires study-calendar.db, an existing server, destructive shared reset, or cleanup that is not failure-safe.
